summary: A FileUpload without its built-in list, opened from an Add files button in the section header; picked names are listed by the page.
use: Upload on pick with your own progress or list UI, and a header button that opens the same picker.
spec: `list={false}` and `multiple`: `onchange` receives only the files just picked and `files` is not kept
`data-testid="attachments-input"` is forwarded to the native file input
The page keeps its own `names` list in `onchange`
